summary: Security hardening checks (login brute-force guard, broker regex escaping) verified via new backend tests; no-regression criterion verified via backend tests + 2 browser checks (local + public preview).

Second test: POST /api/auth/login kumararaja/Raja@1985 (untouched key) -> 200, username kumararaja. Both tests passed.

checks.criterion: Security hardening: broker name regex is escaped
checks.name: test_tscheck_broker_name_regex_escaped.py
checks.evidence: As admin: POST /api/brokers {name:'A.*'} -> 200; POST /api/brokers {name:'ABC'} -> 200 (would have been wrongly rejected as duplicate if 'A.*' were interpreted as a regex matching anything starting with A); POST /api/brokers {name:'A.*'} again -> 409 (exact duplicate). Both fixture broker docs deleted from Mongo `brokers` in a finally block.
